data.why: CAFE expects scaled-expression CSVs named <SampleID>_<Group>.csv with marker columns as the upload format for the Data Processing page; wrote two groups (Control, Treated) of two samples each with a 12-marker panel, one extreme-outlier row (HD01, row 6) to exercise MAD-based QC filtering, and one missing value (PT01, CD16) to exercise the drop-missing-rows path, with marker intensities shifted per group (CD4/CD45ra high in Control, CD38/HLA-DR/CD11c high in Treated) so clustering and group comparison have a real signal to find.

goals: Upload a batch of SFCM scaled-CSV exports, run QC to remove outlier/debris cells, and build a combined AnnData object
Reduce dimensionality (PCA/UMAP) and cluster cells with Leiden to reveal distinct immune cell populations
Check for and correct batch effects between sample runs before downstream comparison
Annotate or merge clusters into named cell types based on marker expression
Compare immune cell population abundance and marker expression statistically across experimental groups (e.g. Control vs Treated)
Export publication-ready figures, tables, and the processed .h5ad object for the final dataset

review.summary: The tree describes CAFE's guided processing pipeline and its cluster-refinement tools accurately, and every screen I sampled matches its node. It leaves out the Visualization page, which handles the group comparison and publication-figure purpose stated in the README and plan, along with manual annotation, cluster evaluation and downsampling. The second agent's replay crashed and confirms nothing, so the tree needs these additions and a fresh check before filing.
